name: Wall Shelf With Mounting Rail
description: Wall-mounted shelf: a 900 x 250 x 30 mm board with a rear mounting upstand and two 6 mm screw holes on 700 mm centers.

steps.instruction: Create the shelf board: 900 mm long (X), 250 mm deep (Y) and 30 mm thick, centered in X and Y with its underside on Z=0. The back (wall) edge is at Y=+125.

transcript.user_prompt: Make a wall shelf. Start with the board: 900 mm long (X), 250 mm deep (Y), 30 mm thick, centered in X and Y with its underside on Z=0 - the back edge at Y=+125 will sit against the wall.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 900 x 250 mm shelf board, 30 mm thick, with its back edge ready to meet the wall.

steps.instruction: Add a mounting upstand along the back edge: 900 mm long, 20 mm thick and 60 mm tall, sitting on the board's top face (Z=30 to Z=90) with its back face flush at Y=125.

transcript.user_prompt: Add a mounting rail: an upstand running the full 900 mm along the back edge, 20 mm thick and 60 mm tall, standing on the board's top face so it spans Z=30 to Z=90, its back face flush with the board's back edge at Y=125.
transcript.assistant_message: The mounting upstand now runs along the back of the shelf, 60 mm tall - that's where it will screw to the wall.

steps.instruction: Drill two 6 mm diameter screw holes horizontally (along Y) through the 20 mm upstand at X=+/-350, Z=60. The upstand is centered at Y=115, so each hole must pass through its full thickness from Y=105 to Y=125.

transcript.user_prompt: Drill the fixing holes: two 6 mm diameter holes straight through the upstand along Y, centered at X=+/-350 (700 mm apart) at mid-rail height Z=60. Remember the upstand sits at the back, centered at Y=115 - the holes must pierce its full 20 mm thickness (Y=105 to Y=125).
transcript.assistant_message: Both 6 mm screw holes are through the rail at 700 mm centers - the shelf is ready to mount.
